> A portable, wireless pocket keypad that connects to my phone via Bluetooth. It features a symmetrical 6-button grid that uses chorded typing combinations to type the full alphabet, numbers, and symbols. It includes a dedicated voice-to-text button and a 3D-printed case with a built-in phone stand for a complete mobile workstation on the go.

## Design

### 2026-10-01 — I officially launched the design phase for my 6-button pocket keypad. I constructed a 3x2 physical layout grid on the online editor and hand-wrote a complete engineering master plan. I mapped out all

**1h**

I officially launched the design phase for my 6-button pocket keypad. I constructed a 3x2 physical layout grid on the online editor and hand-wrote a complete engineering master plan. I mapped out all 26 alphabet characters to chord combinations, set up a dedicated voice-to-text shortcut, integrated a custom mouse layer for phone touch navigation, and set up my public GitHub repository.
